mentions.name: Fillvisa
mentions.description: This open-source tool helps users fill out USCIS immigration forms and the DS-160 without dealing with complicated government PDFs. All forms are available for free, with a paid version offering additional features.
mentions.problem: Most immigration software is expensive and geared toward larger firms, while solo practitioners and document preparers need something simpler and more affordable.
mentions.audience: Solo immigration attorneys, paralegals, document preparers, and DIY applicants
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Fillvisa - a free and open-source alternative to Docketwise, specifically for solo immigration practices, document preparers, and paralegals.

evidence.value: I'm building Fillvisa - a free and open-source alternative to Docketwise, specifically for solo immigration practices, document preparers, and paralegals.
